scope: Compiled imported-character game, original source-pose checks, typed routing, checkpoints and Windows native export.
Windows Vulkan presentation; Linux native headless gameplay. Native UI layout checks require a presentation-enabled build.
This sample has one stationary arm-opening take, not locomotion clips, motion matching, IK or retargeting.

limits: Small flat static yard, one capsule courier and one first-person observer; no game-scale crowd, terrain, performance or physical input qualification.
Stable source poses are compared after inertial transitions finish. Transient native joint state still participates in exact checkpoint/continuation comparisons.
Immediate checkpoint snapshots exclude only session IDs; continued comparisons additionally exclude two explicitly named host save-epoch identity fields.
Virtual native UI bounds/hittability and logical eligibility are separate from physical pointer/controller or desktop-editor usability.
Renderer readbacks are actual gameplay observations, not OS screenshots or a real-time authoring video.
Relocation and isolated environment use the development Windows host, which has .NET installed; this is not a clean-machine deployment test.
Source-free player runs before a separate reconstructed-world pose/save contract; the latter deliberately imports the preserved caller source into its own world.
General save/schema migration, imported locomotion-library compatibility and broader FPS character pipeline remain open.

retained_failed_attempts.reason: Selected older bridge lacked navigation marker; matching bridge used in subsequent runs.
An int64 generation is decimal text on the wire; corrected assertion.
Default menu obscured courier and wrapped labels; replaced with explicitly authored compact footer.
Linux logical-UI build has no native presenter; capability-aware check records unavailable presentation rather than assuming it.
Shipping deliberately clears exactly five authoring-history arrays; verifier now compares every other field unchanged.
Native Windows relative source keys use backslashes; verifier now performs exact canonical-path and hash matching.
